namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

instance : LawfulSyntacticRewriting L (SyntacticSemiformula L) where

@[simp] lemma complexity_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : (ω ▹ φ).complexity = φ.complexity := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rew_rel, rew_nrel]

section

variable (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂)

@[simp] lemma eq_top_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : ω ▹ φ = (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂) ↔ φ = ⊤ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_bot_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : ω ▹ φ = (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂) ↔ φ = ⊥ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_rel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.rel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.rel r v' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

lemma eq_nrel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hnrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

@[simp] lemma eq_and_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_or_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    ω ▹ φ = ∀' ψ ↔ ∃ φ' : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ' = ψ ∧ φ = ∀' φ' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_ex_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    ω ▹ φ = ∃' ψ ↔ ∃ φ' : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ' = ψ ∧ φ = ∃' φ' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ➝ φ₂ := by
  simp [imp_eq]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, hp₁, ψ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; exact ⟨∼φ₁, by simp [hp₁]⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; exact ⟨∼φ₁, by simp, φ₂, by simp⟩

lemma eq_ball_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    (ω ▹ φ = ∀[ψ₁] ψ₂) ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω.q ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = ∀[φ₁] φ₂ := by
  simp [ball, eq_all_iff]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ', ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; simp

lemma eq_bex_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    (ω ▹ φ = ∃[ψ₁] ψ₂) ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω.q ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = ∃[φ₁] φ₂ := by
  simp [bex, eq_ex_iff]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ', ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; simp

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

C0_dependencies.name: _private.0.LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.map_inj
C0_dependencies.content:
private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

informal_statement: The behavior of a statement $\rho \statement \alpha$ is equivalent to the behavior of $\rho^\circ \statement \alpha'$, where $\alpha'$ is obtained by replacing each free variable in $\rho^\circ$ with a bound variable that conforms to the naming conventions of the system. That is, for any formula $\varphi$, the use of $\rho \statement \alpha$ is conditionally the same as using $\rho^\circ \statement \alpha'$, differing only by the renaming of bound variables.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence between $\rho \statement \alpha$ and $\rho^\circ \statement \alpha'$, we will proceed by induction on the structure of $\varphi$, decomposing the proof into several cases based on how $\varphi$ is formed.

1. **Base Cases:**
   - **Literals:**
     If $\varphi$ is a literal (i.e., an atom or constant), then both $\rho \statement \alpha$ and $\rho^\circ \statement \alpha'$ behave identically since they only depend on the truth value of the literal. The equivalence propagates directly without any changes to bound variables.
   
   - **Parameters and Contexts:**
     Any parameters outside of the formula's scope remain unchanged. Since $\rho^\circ$ is a transformed version of $\rho$, differences in the parameters do not affect the condition based on the content of the formula.

2. **Inductive Step:**
   - **Conjunction and Disjunction:**
     For compound formulas formed by logical connectives such as $\land$, $\lor$, or $\Rightarrow$, the behavior of $\rho \statement \alpha$ can be derived from the behaviors of its constituent subformulas. For $\rho \statement \alpha$ to hold, each subformula must satisfy their respective conditions. After transformation to $\rho^\circ$, the same logic applies, yielding the equivalence for the entire compound formula. The substitution $\alpha'$ will adjust to accommodate any variable renormalization necessary for the transformed pattern.

   - **Universal Quantifiers:**
     When dealing with universal quantifiers, $\rho \statement \alpha$ ensures that for every element in the domain, a certain condition holds. Since $\rho^\circ$ is a systematic transformation of $\rho$, applying universal quantification over $\rho^\circ$ in $\alpha'$ will preserve this condition, as each universal variable is appropriately renamed during the transformation process.

   - **Existential Quantifiers:**
     Conversely, for existential quantifiers, $\rho \statement \alpha$ asserts that there exists at least one element in the domain satisfying the condition. The transformation to $\rho^\circ$ ensures that such an element, after adjusting for variable names in $\alpha'$, continues to satisfy the condition.

   - **Implications:**
     For implications $\rho \Rightarrow \varphi$, the equivalence relies on the preservation of the antecedent and consequent through the transformation $\rho \to \rho^\circ$. The substitution $\alpha'$ will correctly align any referenced parameters, maintaining the truth value of the implication.

3. **Conclusion:**
   By systematically applying the inductive reasoning across all structural cases of $\varphi$, we ensure that the behavior of $\rho \statement \alpha$ and $\rho^\circ \statement \alpha'$ remains equivalent. The key lies in meticulously handling variable substitutions and renormalizations to maintain the correspondence between the original and transformed statements. This process confirms that the semantical equality holds, and hence:
   
   $\forall \varphi,\; \rho \statement \alpha \; \Longleftrightarrow \; \rho^\circ \statement \alpha'$.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where

@[simp] lemma complexity_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : (ω ▹ φ).complexity = φ.complexity := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_top_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : ω ▹ φ = (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂) ↔ φ = ⊤ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_bot_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : ω ▹ φ = (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂) ↔ φ = ⊥ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_rel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.rel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.rel r v' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

lemma eq_nrel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hnrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

@[simp] lemma eq_and_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_or_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    ω ▹ φ = ∀' ψ ↔ ∃ φ' : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ' = ψ ∧ φ = ∀' φ' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

instance : LawfulSyntacticRewriting L (SyntacticSemiformula L) where

@[simp] lemma complexity_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : (ω ▹ φ).complexity = φ.complexity := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rew_rel, rew_nrel]

  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp

  case hnrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

    ω ▹ φ = ∃' ψ ↔ ∃ φ' : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ' = ψ ∧ φ = ∃' φ' := by

    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ➝ φ₂ := by

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

rag.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.rec'
rag.content:
@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

def lMapAux (Φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) : ∀ {n}, Semiformula L₁ ξ n → Semiformula L₂ ξ n
  | _, ⊤        => ⊤
  | _, ⊥        => ⊥
  | _, rel r v  => rel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, nrel r v => nrel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋏ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋎ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, ∀' φ     => ∀' lMapAux Φ φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => ∃' lMapAux Φ φ

rag.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
rag.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by

  smul_map_injective := map_inj

@[simp] lemma complexity_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : (ω ▹ φ).complexity = φ.complexity := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rew_rel, rew_nrel]

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

instance : LawfulSyntacticRewriting L (SyntacticSemiformula L) where

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: _private.0.LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.map_inj
C0_dependencies.content:
private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

/-- `coe_substs_eq_substs_coe` -/
lemma embedding_substitute_eq_substitute_embedding
    [Rewriting L ο O ο O] [Rewriting L ο O ξ F] [Rewriting L ξ F ξ F]
    [TransitiveRewriting L ο O ο O ξ F]
    [TransitiveRewriting L ο O ξ F ξ F]
    (φ : O k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ο n) :
    (embedding (ξ := ξ) (φ ⇜ v)) = Rewriting.substitute (ξ := ξ) (embedding (ξ := ξ) φ) (fun i ↦ Rew.emb (v i)) := by
  unfold embedding substitute
  rw [←comp_app, ←comp_app]
  congr 2
  ext x
  · simp [Rew.comp_app]
  · exact IsEmpty.elim inferInstance x

    [TransitiveRewriting L ο O ξ F ξ F]
    (φ : O 1) (t : Semiterm L ο n) :
    (embedding (ξ := ξ) (φ/[t])) = (embedding (ξ := ξ) φ)/[(Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n)] := by
  simpa [Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using embedding_substitute_eq_substitute_embedding φ ![t]

informal_statement: For any semisentence φ of type L with index k and any family of semiterms v_i of type L with index n indexed by Fin k, the substitution of v into φ and then coercion to the syntax of type L with index n is equivalent to coercion of φ to the syntax of type L with index k followed by substitution of the coerced v_i.
informal_proof:
To understand why substitution and coercion commute in this context, consider the definitions of these operations within the logical framework.

1. **Substitution (φ ⇜ v)**: This operation replaces each variable in the semisentence φ with the corresponding term from the family v, yielding a new semisentence. Specifically, each variable denoted by v_i in φ is replaced by the term v_i, which is a semiterm of type L with index n.

2. **Coercion (↑)**: This operation maps a semisentence from one type to another, effectively changing the index from k to n in this case. It ensures that the syntax is appropriately adapted to the new type while preserving the meaning and structure of the original semisentence.

When we apply substitution followed by coercion (φ ⇜ v and then ↑), we are first modifying φ by replacing its variables with the terms from v, and then adapting the resulting semisentence to the new index n. Conversely, when we apply coercion followed by substitution (first ↑φ and then substituting the coerced v_i), we are first adapting φ to the new index and then modifying it by replacing its variables with the coerced terms v_i.

Because both substitution and coercion are defined in a way that respects the structure and meaning of the original semisentence, the final result of these two operations will be the same. This commutativity is ensured by the underlying properties of the rewriting lemma `Rewriting.embedding_substitute_eq_substitute_embedding φ v`, which formalizes the equality between these two processes.

Therefore, substitution and coercion commute in this context, as their definitions are designed to preserve the equivalence of the two resulting expressions despite the different order of operations.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

instance : LawfulSyntacticRewriting L (SyntacticSemiformula L) where

@[simp] lemma complexity_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : (ω ▹ φ).complexity = φ.complexity := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rew_rel, rew_nrel]

variable (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂)

@[simp] lemma eq_top_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : ω ▹ φ = (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂) ↔ φ = ⊤ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_bot_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : ω ▹ φ = (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂) ↔ φ = ⊥ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_rel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.rel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.rel r v' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

lemma eq_nrel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v' := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  case hnrel k' r' v =>
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]

@[simp] lemma eq_and_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

@[simp] lemma eq_or_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ := by
  cases φ using Semiformula.rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]

lemma eq_all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    ω ▹ φ = ∀' ψ ↔ ∃ φ' : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ' = ψ ∧ φ = ∀' φ' := by
  exact?

def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

variable (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂)
informal_statement: For any propositions \( a \) and \( b \), the conjunction \( a \land b \) is logically equivalent to \( b \land a \).
informal_proof:
First, we consider two arbitrary propositions \( a \) and \( b \).

Next, we aim to prove the equivalence \( a \land b \leftrightarrow b \land a \). To do this, we will prove both directions of the equivalence.

**Forward Direction (\( a \land b \rightarrow b \land a \)):**
Assume \( a \land b \) is true. By the definition of logical conjunction, both \( a \) and \( b \) must be true. Since both \( a \) and \( b \) are true, the conjunction \( b \land a \) is also true. Thus, \( a \land b \rightarrow b \land a \) holds.

**Reverse Direction (\( b \land a \rightarrow a \land b \)):**
Conversely, assume \( b \land a \) is true. Again, by the definition of logical conjunction, both \( b \) and \( a \) must be true. Since both \( b \) and \( a \) are true, the conjunction \( a \land b \) is also true. Thus, \( b \land a \rightarrow a \land b \) holds.

Since both directions have been proven, we conclude that \( a \land b \leftrightarrow b \land a \) is universally true for any propositions \( a \) and \( b \).

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset
