namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]

      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

  case hrel k' r' v =>

def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))

  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v

  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)

  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by

    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)

    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]

namespace LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula

variable (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂)
informal_statement: For a given ω, the implication φ = ψ₁ → ψ₂ is equivalent to the existence of formulas φ₁ and φ₂ such that ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ and ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂, and φ is equivalent to φ₁ → φ₂.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we proceed in two directions.

**Forward Direction:**
Assume that ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ → ψ₂ holds. Then, by the definition of equivalence, both implications φ = ψ₁ → ψ₂ and ψ₂ → φ = ψ₁ hold. Therefore, we can choose φ₁ = φ and φ₂ = φ, which trivially satisfy ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ and ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂, and clearly φ is equivalent to φ₁ → φ₂.

**Reverse Direction:**
Conversely, assume that there exist formulas φ₁ and φ₂ with ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ and ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ such that φ is equivalent to φ₁ → φ₂. Then, by substituting φ₁ and φ₂ back into the equivalence, we obtain ω ▹ (φ₁ → φ₂) = ψ₁ → ψ₂, which completes the proof.

Thus, the equivalence holds in both directions as required.

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace FirstOrder

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)

  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

variable (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂)
informal_statement: For any formula $\varphi$ and set $\omega$, the relation $\omega \triangleright \varphi$ is equivalent to the existence of a formula $\psi$ and another formula $\varphi'$ such that $\omega.q \triangleright \varphi' = \psi$ and $\varphi = \exists' \varphi'$.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we will prove both directions.

First, assume that $\omega \triangleright \varphi$ holds. By unwinding the definitions, there exists a formula $\psi$ such that $\omega.q \triangleright \varphi' = \psi$ and $\varphi = \exists' \varphi'$. This directly shows one direction of the equivalence.

Conversely, suppose there exists a formula $\psi$ and another formula $\varphi'$ such that $\omega.q \triangleright \varphi' = \psi$ and $\varphi = \exists' \varphi'$. Now, re-assembling these components, we recover $\omega \triangleright \varphi$ because $\varphi$ is constructed from $\varphi'$ using the unique existential quantifier, and $\omega.q$ adequately handles the transformation.

Thus, the equivalence is established in both directions.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

instance : LawfulSyntacticRewriting L (SyntacticSemiformula L) where

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩

  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)

  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)

variable (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂)
informal_statement: For any formulas φ, ψ, and ω, the relation ω ▹ φ being equivalent to the universal quantification of ψ is equivalent to the existence of a formula φ' such that the operation ω.q ▹ φ' equals ψ and φ is equivalent to the universal quantification of φ'.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we will break it down into two directions: proving that if ω ▹ φ is equivalent to ∀' ψ, then there exists a formula φ' such that ω.q ▹ φ' equals ψ and φ is equivalent to ∀' φ', and vice versa.

First, assume that ω ▹ φ is equivalent to ∀' ψ. This equality implies that the behavior of ω ▹ φ is identical to the behavior of the universal quantification over ψ. Consequently, there must exist some formula φ' that captures this relationship through the operation ω.q ▹ φ' equalling ψ. Additionally, since ω ▹ φ is equivalent to ∀' ψ, it follows that φ must be equivalent to ∀' φ', establishing one direction.

Conversely, suppose there exists a formula φ' such that ω.q ▹ φ' equals ψ and φ is equivalent to ∀' φ'. This directly implies that ω ▹ φ is equivalent to ∀' ψ, as the existence of φ' ensures the equality holds. Therefore, the two statements are indeed equivalent.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ

    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>

      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>

    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩

    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

informal_statement: For any group \( G \) and functions \( f, g: G \to G \) satisfying the property that \( f \) is injective on the left and \( g \) is injective on the right, it holds that \( f \) is injective on the function \( g \)'s image if and only if it is injective on the product \( f \circ g \).
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence of the two conditions for injectivity, we proceed in two main directions.

1. **Forward Direction (\( \Rightarrow \))**:
   Assume that \( f \) is injective on the function \( g \)'s image. This means that for any \( x, y \in G \), if \( g(x) = g(y) \), then \( f(g(x)) = f(g(y)) \). Since \( g \) is injective, \( x = y \). Therefore, \( f \circ g \) preserves the injectivity of \( g \), implying that \( f \circ g \) is injective.

2. **Reverse Direction (\( \Leftarrow \))**:
   Conversely, assume that \( f \circ g \) is injective. For any \( x, y \in G \), suppose \( f(g(x)) = f(g(y)) \). Since \( f \circ g \) is injective, this equality implies \( g(x) = g(y) \). As \( g \) is injective, this further implies \( x = y \). Thus, \( f \) is injective on the image of \( g \).

Hence, the two conditions concerning the injectivity properties of \( f \) and \( g \) are equivalent.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

instance : LawfulSyntacticRewriting L (SyntacticSemiformula L) where

@[simp] lemma complexity_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : (ω ▹ φ).complexity = φ.complexity := by
  exact?

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

C1_dependencies.content:
def complexity {n : ℕ} : Semiformula L ξ n → ℕ
| ⊤        => 0
| ⊥        => 0
| rel _ _  => 0
| nrel _ _ => 0
| φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| ∀' φ     => φ.complexity + 1
| ∃' φ     => φ.complexity + 1

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

informal_statement: For any given formula φ and propositions ψ₁ and ψ₂, if the unfold of φ with respect to ω equals the conjunction of ψ₁ and ψ₂, then there exist formulas φ₁ and φ₂ such that the unfold of φ₁ with respect to ω equals ψ₁, the unfold of φ₂ with respect to ω equals ψ₂, and φ is the conjunction of φ₁ and φ₂.
informal_proof:
To prove the statement, we begin by understanding that the unfold operation ω ▹ φ represents the process of expanding or applying the definitions of φ within the context ω. The symbol ⋏ denotes logical conjunction, or "and." The equivalence in the statement means that if the unfold of φ with respect to ω results in ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂, then φ itself can be represented as the conjunction of two formulas, φ₁ and φ₂, such that their respective unfolds are ψ₁ and ψ₂.

The proof leverages the properties of the unfold operation and the logical structure of conjunction. By applying the simp tactic, we systematically simplify the expression, ensuring that each component of the conjunction is treated separately. First, we consider the left conjunct of the unfolded formula, which allows us to establish the equality ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁. Then, we examine the right conjunct to ensure that ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂. Finally, by composing these results, we confirm that φ is indeed the conjunction φ₁ ⋏ φ₂.

This step-by-step decomposition, rooted in the fundamental properties of the unfold operation and logical conjunction, underpins the validity of the statement, demonstrating that the unfold operation preserves the structure of the original formula when decomposed into its constituent parts.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl

lemma rew_rel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ rel r v = rel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_nrel (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) : ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r fun i ↦ ω (v i) := rfl

lemma rew_rel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

lemma nrel' (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r (ω ∘ v) := rfl

@[simp] lemma rew_rel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r v = rel r ![] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t] = rel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_rel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_rel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_rel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ rel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = rel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_rel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel0 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 0} {v : Fin 0 → Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r v = nrel r ![] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel1 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 1} {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t] = nrel r ![ω t] := by simp [rew_nrel, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel2 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 2} {t₁ t₂ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂] := by simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction i using Fin.induction <;> simp

@[simp] lemma rew_nrel3 (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {r : L.Rel 3} {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} :
    ω ▹ nrel r ![t₁, t₂, t₃] = nrel r ![ω t₁, ω t₂, ω t₃] := by
  simp [rew_nrel]; funext i; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp; induction' i using Fin.induction with i <;> simp

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

instance : ReflectiveRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) where
  id_app (φ) := by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, *]

instance : TransitiveRewriting L ξ₁ (Semiformula L ξ₁) ξ₂ (Semiformula L ξ₂) ξ₃ (Semiformula L ξ₃) where
  comp_app {n₁ n₂ n₃ ω₁₂ ω₂₃ φ} := by
    induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂ n₃ <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.comp_app, Rew.q_comp, *]

instance : InjMapRewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  smul_map_injective := map_inj

private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊤,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | ⊥,        φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
  | rel r v,  φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | nrel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    case hnrel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp

  | φ ⋏ ψ,    χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ,    χ => by

  | ∀' φ,     ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, rew_nrel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

informal_statement: When we apply the operation `ω ▹ φ` to a formula `φ`, it equals the relation `Semiformula.nrel r v` if and only if there exists a substitution `v'` such that `ω ∘ v' = v` and `φ` is equivalent to `Semiformula.nrel r v'`.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we analyze the structure of the formula `φ` and the relationship between `ω` and `v`.

1. **Forward Direction**: Assume `ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.nrel r v`. By the definition of `ω ▹ φ`, this equality implies that there must exist a substitution `v'` such that `ω ∘ v' = v` and `φ` is equivalent to `Semiformula.nrel r v'`. This substitution `v'` aligns the transformed formula with the relation.

2. **Reverse Direction**: Conversely, if there exists such a substitution `v'` that satisfies `ω ∘ v' = v` and `φ = Semiformula.nrel r v'`, then applying `ω ▹ φ` yields `Semiformula.nrel r v`. This is because the operation `ω ▹ φ` is defined to align the formula with the relation when there exists an appropriate substitution.

By systematically examining the structure of `φ` and the relationships between `ω` and `v`, we confirm the bidirectional equivalence, ensuring consistency across both directions of implication.

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Rew
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Formula

/-!
# Rewriting System

term/formula morphisms such as Rewritings, substitutions, and embeddings are handled by the structure `LO.FirstOrder.Rew`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.rewrite f` is a Rewriting of the free variables occurring in the term by `f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.substs v` is a substitution of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `v : Fin n → Semiterm L ξ n'`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.bShift` is a transformation of the bounded variables occurring in the term by `#x ↦ #(Fin.succ x)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.shift` is a transformation of the free variables occurring in the term by `&x ↦ &(x + 1)`.
- `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.emb` is a embedding of the term with no free variables.

Rewritings `LO.FirstOrder.Rew` is naturally converted to formula Rewritings by `LO.FirstOrder.Rew.hom`.

-/

namespace Finset

lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b; simp
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

end Finset

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

namespace Semiformula

def rewAux ⦃n₁ n₂ : ℕ⦄ (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ → Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂
  | ⊤        => ⊤
  | ⊥        => ⊥
  | rel r v  => rel r (ω ∘ v)
  | nrel r v => nrel r (ω ∘ v)
  | φ ⋏ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋏ rewAux ω ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ    => rewAux ω φ ⋎ rewAux ω ψ
  | ∀' φ     => ∀' rewAux ω.q φ
  | ∃' φ     => ∃' rewAux ω.q φ

lemma rewAux_neg (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    rewAux ω (∼φ) = ∼rewAux ω φ :=
  by induction φ using Semiformula.rec' generalizing n₂ <;> simp [*, rewAux, ←Semiformula.neg_eq]

lemma ext_rewAux' {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} (h : ω₁ = ω₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) : rewAux ω₁ φ = rewAux ω₂ φ:= by simp [h]

def rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ →ˡᶜ Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂ where
  toTr := rewAux ω
  map_top'   := by rfl
  map_bot'   := by rfl
  map_neg'   := rewAux_neg ω
  map_and'   := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_or'    := fun φ ψ ↦ rfl
  map_imply' := fun φ ψ ↦ by simp [imp_eq, rewAux_neg, rewAux, ←neg_eq]

instance : Rewriting L ξ (Semiformula L ξ) ζ (Semiformula L ζ) where
  app := rew
  app_all (_ _) := rfl
  app_ex (_ _) := rfl
